title: Recruited into Army intelligence by a civilian in the Fort Jackson beer hall

tellings.quote: and so when I went in the trailer I found out that he was a guy who was in intelligence

plain: In the 1960s, at Fort Jackson, an Army training base in South Carolina, a young soldier named Joe McMoneagle was approached by a civilian in the base beer hall and later followed him to a trailer, where he found out the man worked in intelligence. McMoneagle, who went on to become one of the Army's remote viewers, people trained to try to describe far-off places with the mind alone, tells this as the start of his own path into Army intelligence.
